Welcome to Offkit
PDF tools that work entirely on your phone.
Four tools
Choose the quality and see the size before you save.
Make a PDF smaller, with three levels to choose from.
Put PDFs in order, then combine them into one.
Add pictures as new pages to an existing PDF.
Private by design
No internet connection and no permissions.
No accounts and no ads.
Your files never leave your device.
Location and camera details are removed from photos placed into PDFs.
You\'re in control
You choose the files, and where results are saved.
Recently saved files appear on the home screen.
Nothing is uploaded or backed up.
